verdict.rationale: Nothing in the pack documents user-facing flags or options for memory locking, mmap behavior, or other low-level engine overrides. The mmap discussion (llama-cpp-comm-1) covers a change to how the engine itself loads models, not a setting users can control. The N_GPU_LAYERS mention (llama-cpp-comm-9) comes through third-party Python wrappers and describes a limit rather than a documented override.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can override low-level engine settings like memory locking or mmap behavior instead of being limited to opinionated defaults
